properties.description:
The overnight browser sweep reproduced a pre-existing Windows line-ending problem in the private-space recovery view. After Restore missing setup loads a CRLF private-space.ts, the untouched textarea exposes LF text, while dirty detection compares it directly with the raw CRLF service response. Retry startup incorrectly says "Save the edited script before retrying startup."

Fix dirty-state comparison at the recovery view boundary without changing the source revision used for stale-write protection. Keep unchanged files unchanged. Verify inspect, reload, restore, save and retry for both LF and CRLF, with real edits still requiring Save. The existing private-space-recovery-ui fixture also assumes textarea repair preserves CRLF; author deterministic input and retain exact saved-content assertions.

Evidence: .harness/checkpoints/run-Yimvuc/report.json; Systems/Depth4/HarnessApp/test-results/run-1793429319085-beb4688c/private-space-recovery-ui--4769b-it-through-the-local-engine/error-context.md; isolated restoration failure in test-results/run-1793429800328-5767beba. Recovery production code is unchanged from 81fede0. This is separate from task deletion, multi-selection and LSP folding.
properties.title: Fix recovery dirty detection for Windows line endings
